markets.rationale: The UTC day completes after the market stops trading at 22:00 UTC.
The CoinGecko UTC daily close is known after the market stops trading at 22:00 UTC.
YES becomes irreversible if the official count reaches six while trading remains open; NO is not exact before the publication window ends.
Regular trading begins after the Delphi market closes at 13:25 UTC.
The organizer-named Wikimedia endpoint exposes only completed daily aggregates, so neither outcome is authoritative before trading closes at 23:00 UTC.
The measured settlement period begins one hour after the Delphi market closes.
The NOAA observation window begins one hour after the Delphi market closes.
Sporting KC-St. Louis kicks off exactly when trading closes, so no final-result outcome can be known while the market is open.
The Treasury's governing 10-year input quotation is observed around 15:30 ET, six and a half hours after Delphi trading closes.
The governing NOAA Battery water-level observation window begins one hour after Delphi trading closes.
Rayo Vallecano-Alavés kicks off exactly when trading closes, so the draw result cannot be known while the market is open.
Botafogo-Cienciano kicks off exactly when trading closes, so the four-or-more-goals result cannot be known while the market is open.
YES becomes irreversible if Google publicly releases or makes available a numerically versioned Gemini 3.5-or-later Pro model before close; NO is exact only after the deadline.
YES becomes irreversible upon a qualifying new official AARO or ODNI UAP-record release in the stated window; NO is exact only after the window closes.
The governing WTI settlement window runs through Delphi's 18:30 UTC close and the official settlement is published afterward, so neither result is exact while trading is open.
